title: KPI limits
description: Meta-schema for standard/kpi-limits/*.json (owner 28.09.): the deviations of a KPI, kept apart from its definition — a Rule 'KPI below/above X'. alarmWhen 'below': the KPI is bad when it falls (warning at or below `warning`, critical at or below `critical`; critical <= warning <= target); 'above': bad when it rises (critical >= warning >= target). The order of the three numbers is checked by the KPI linter.

kpiId.description: The KPI these limits are for (standard/kpis/*.json kpiId)

appliesTo.description: Only for these classes; absent = every class the KPI applies to

owner.description: Who signs a change of these limits (a domain of the governance)
